name: com.streethawk.library.feedback.SHFeedbackActivity
description: This component is part of the StreetHawk mobile engagement SDK. StreetHawk opens this Activity for campaign feedback requests. The user can enter a subject and message, submit it to StreetHawk, and send an accepted or canceled result for the prompt.
disableEffect: Users will not be able to submit feedback through StreetHawk's older campaign form.
